_note: Recolour variants of kit creatures (docs/art/pirates-style.md section 17), built by scripts/variants.py: 'swap' moves every step of one ramp onto a run of another ([from, to, first, last]: step i of 'from' becomes step first + round(i * (last - first) / (len(from) - 1)) of 'to'), or 'mood' applies a mood table from pirates-moods.json to the one tile. A variant costs a picture slot but no drawing. CC BY 4.0.

parrot-blue.why: a blue-and-gold macaw, a second Friend
